# Roadmap import format (TSV)
Load when: background on the TSV format; playbooks import and import-links already hold the steps
Applies to: lpm-roadmap-owner-ops    Source: cards `preview_workspace_roadmap_import`, `commit_workspace_roadmap_import`, `resolve_workspace_roadmap_dependencies`, `suggest_workspace_roadmap_allocations` (`parseRoadmapTsv`, `buildRoadmapItemFromImportRow`, `resolveRoadmapDependencies`, `suggestRoadmapProjectAllocations`)

## Summary
The content is TAB-separated text: first line = headers, one item per row.
Preview writes nothing; commit creates one item per row with lifecycle `imported`.
Dependencies and allocations are separate steps after the commit, each with a read-only preview.
Without `roadmapId` every commit creates a NEW roadmap: a blind retry duplicates everything.

## Facts
### Columns (headers are case- and accent-insensitive)
| Header (any of) | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| title, titulo, name, nome, funcionalidade | item title (required per row) | empty → row skipped with warning "Row N ignored because title is empty." |
| description, descricao, summary, resumo | item description | — |
| category, categoria, type, tipo | item category | — |
| capability, capacidade, capabilidade | capability name | a missing capability is created by name on commit |
| depends on, dependencias, depends, blocks | list separated by `;` `,` or `\|` | `blocks` is read as depends-on (the row depends on the reference): confirm the direction with the owner |
| id, source id, codigo | source id | dependency references match this id or the exact title |
| status, situacao | original status | kept as `originalStatus` only |
| priority, prioridade | `0`/`0.5`=urgent, `1`=high, `2`=medium, `3`=low, `4`=none, or urgente/alta/media/baixa | unrecognized → none |

### Preview and commit
| Field / value | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| `rowCount == 0` or warning "Roadmap import is empty." | no TAB-separated header with a title column | convert CSV to TSV and preview again; never commit |
| row `idempotencyKey` | built from sourceRef, id, title, category and row number | keep `sourceRef` and row order identical between preview and commit |
| commit `content` | must be exactly the previewed TSV | never edit the text between the two calls |
| commit without `roadmapId` | creates a new draft roadmap (title = `title`, else sourceRef) and stores `sourceRef` | result lost → find it in the overview `roadmaps[]` by `sourceRef`/`title` before any retry |
| commit with an unknown `roadmapId` | silently creates a roadmap with that id | take roadmapId only from the overview `roadmaps[]` |
| commit with `roadmapId` | rows whose key already exists there are skipped | compare `createdItemIds.length` with `importedRows` |
| `importedRows` | rows parsed, NOT rows created | count created items with `createdItemIds` |
| empty or invalid content on commit | still creates an empty roadmap | always preview first |
| enforce mode | commit does not check it; no change-request type imports | playbook import asks a confirmation that names enforce; never "needs a change request" |

### Dependencies and allocations after the import
| Field / value | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| resolve without `confirmed` | read-only: `candidates[]`, `unresolved[]`, `cycles[]` | safe to run; show the result |
| `selectedDependencyKeys` | `"<sourceItemId>:<targetItemId>:depends_on"` | build each key yourself from approved candidates |
| any `cycles` entry | blocks the whole commit, even keys outside it | report the cycle; fix item references or create links one by one |
| existing links | skipped | a retry is safe |
| suggest without `confirmed` | read-only: up to 3 `candidates[]` per unallocated item | show project, role, confidence, rationale |
| `confidence <= 0.49` ("Weak routing terms only") | no ownership term matched | ask the owner for the project |
| two `primary` candidates for one item | tied scores; commit does not enforce one primary | select at most one primary per item |
| `selectedAllocationKeys` | `"<itemId>:<projectId>"`; only keys present in `candidates[]` are created | another project → direct allocation; committed ones get routingSource `hybrid` |

## Rules
1. Preview before every commit; commit only after the owner said "import" for that preview.
2. Reuse the same `content` and `sourceRef` in preview and commit.
3. After a timeout on a commit without roadmapId, look for the new roadmap in `get_workspace_roadmap_overview`(compact=true) `roadmaps[]` by `sourceRef`; found → no retry (one atomic batch). With roadmapId: re-read `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, then retry with the same roadmapId.
4. Verify: a new roadmap holds exactly `rowCount` items.

## Examples
```text
example TSV (TAB between columns):
id	title	category	priority	depends on
R1	Login with SSO	auth	alta
R2	Audit log	security	2	R1
example key: selectedDependencyKeys=["<itemId of R2>:<itemId of R1>:depends_on"]
```
